item.title: Christmas Day Gasoline Prices Set To Fall To Covid-Era Levels
item.description: U.S. gasoline prices are set to fall to the lowest level since 2020, thanks to increasing supplies, despite some ongoing refinery maintenance, GasBuddy has predicted. GasBuddy has predicted that U.S. motorists will pay an average of $2.79 per gallon on Christmas Day, down from $2.95 per gallon a year ago. item.title: The Unbelievable Rise of Heat Pumps in the Coldest Places on Earth
item.description: For years, heat pumps were seen as the fragile heroes of mild climates, efficient in theory but unreliable when the mercury dropped. item.title: A New Solar Material Is Pushing Efficiency Beyond Theoretical Limits
item.description: For years, perovskites have been hailed as the "holy grail" of solar energy thanks to their promise of highly efficient and cheaper solar cells.
